answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique tool library membership with tool library attestation — loans the library recorded across years of members — which makes the beacon of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own loans the library recorded across years of members, and the pigment grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the relic of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
